translated: I'm so happy.

when all four of us are finally together for the original vocal parts,
it really makes Ena feel like, "Ah, we really are a four-person unit."

Last year, it felt like Ena finally became Ena, in a way.

but this will feel even more complete, right?
I'm sure it will.
I'm fired up!
I can't wait.
Me too, I'm looking forward to it.
We're in your hands again this year.

Let's do it.

Thank you so much.
Everyone is so kind.

Kon-niigo-niigo!
"I love Niigo's Ena and Mizuki, and Momojan's Shizuku-sama."
